D: A company of Australian and New Zealand soldiers fight outnumbered in a rubber plantation in Vietnam.
P: Serve the main when 11 Platoon calls the artillery in close.
S: Nui Dat concert night satay skewers
Satay for the Little Pattie show D Company misses

Chargrilled chicken skewers marinated in lemongrass and turmeric, with a chunky peanut satay sauce, cucumber and lime. Toss 600g diced chicken thigh with 1 chopped lemongrass stalk, 1 tsp turmeric, 2 garlic cloves, 1 tbsp fish sauce and 1 tbsp brown sugar and marinate 30 minutes. Thread onto 12 skewers and grill 8 minutes, turning. Simmer 150g crunchy peanut butter, 200ml coconut milk, 1 tbsp soy, 1 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tsp chilli and lime juice for 3 minutes. Serve with cucumber and lime wedges.
Phuoc Tuy prawn rice paper rolls
Fresh rolls of prawn, vermicelli, carrot and cucumber

Fresh rice paper rolls with prawns, vermicelli, mint, coriander and crunchy vegetables, with a nuoc cham dipping sauce. Soak 100g rice vermicelli in hot water for 5 minutes and drain. Halve 12 peeled cooked prawns lengthways. Julienne 1 carrot and 1 cucumber. Dip 12 rice paper sheets one at a time in warm water for a few seconds. Lay prawns, noodles, vegetables, mint and coriander on each and roll tightly. Mix 3 tbsp fish sauce, 3 tbsp lime juice, 2 tbsp sugar, 3 tbsp water, 1 garlic clove and chilli for dipping.
M: D Company field kitchen beef and beans
Beef and beans on rice. Smith won't leave 11 Platoon behind

Chuck steak slow-cooked with smoky paprika, tomato and beans until tender, served with buttered rice and pickled chilli for a kick. Brown 800g diced chuck in batches in 2 tbsp oil. Add 1 diced onion, 2 garlic cloves and 1 diced capsicum and cook 5 minutes. Stir in 2 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp cumin, 400g tin crushed tomatoes, 400ml beef stock and a drained 400g tin cannellini beans. Cover and simmer 2 hours until tender. Cook 300g rice and stir through 20g butter. Serve with sliced pickled chilli.
a hot plate before the long patrol

Pork belly braised in dark caramel, fish sauce and coconut water with boiled eggs, jasmine rice and cucumber. Boil the eggs for 8 minutes, cool and peel. Cut the pork into 4cm pieces. Melt the sugar in a heavy pot over medium heat until dark amber, then stir in the sliced shallots and garlic. Add the pork and toss for 5 minutes, then add the fish sauce and coconut water. Simmer gently, half covered, for 1 hour 15 minutes, adding the eggs for the last 20 minutes, until the pork is tender and the sauce sticky. Simmer the rice with 450ml water, covered, for 12 minutes, then rest for 5. Serve with the rice, sliced cucumber, spring onion and chilli.
W: Dark chocolate cream pots scented with orange

Rich dark chocolate and orange pots topped with whipped cream, candied orange zest and a crumble of shortbread for crunch. Heat 300ml thickened cream with the zest of 1 orange until steaming. Pour over 200g chopped dark chocolate, leave 1 minute and stir until smooth. Stir in 1 tbsp orange juice. Pour into 4 small glasses and chill 2 hours. Simmer thin strips of orange zest in 2 tbsp sugar and 2 tbsp water for 3 minutes. Top the pots with whipped cream, the candied zest and crumbled shortbread.
K: Strong dark-roast coffee with condensed milk over ice

Strong dark-roast coffee dripped over sweetened condensed milk, stirred and poured over ice, the Vietnamese way. Brew 500ml very strong dark-roast coffee, using a Vietnamese phin filter if you have one or a plunger at double strength. Spoon 2 tbsp condensed milk into each of 4 glasses. Pour the hot coffee over and stir until creamy. Fill with ice and stir again until cold.

dishes.n: Nui Dat concert night satay skewers
dishes.make_ahead: Marinate up to 1 day ahead, grill fresh

steps.text: Dice the chicken and toss with chopped lemongrass, turmeric, garlic, fish sauce and brown sugar.
Marinate in the fridge for 30 minutes.
Thread onto skewers.
Grill, turning.
Simmer the peanut butter, coconut milk, soy, brown sugar, chilli and lime juice into a satay sauce.
Serve with cucumber and lime wedges.

veg.n: Nui Dat concert night tofu satay skewers
veg.make_ahead: Marinate up to 1 day ahead, grill fresh

steps.text: Press the tofu under a heavy board, then cut into cubes and toss with chopped lemongrass, turmeric, garlic, 2 tbsp of the soy, half the brown sugar and the oil.
Marinate in the fridge for 30 minutes.
Thread onto skewers.
Grill, turning, until golden.
Simmer the peanut butter, coconut milk, the rest of the soy and brown sugar, chilli and lime juice into a satay sauce.
Serve with cucumber and lime wedges.

Julienne the carrot and cucumber.
Dip the rice paper sheets one at a time in warm water for a few seconds.
Lay prawns, noodles, vegetables, mint and coriander on each and roll tightly.
Mix the fish sauce, lime juice, sugar, water, garlic and chilli for dipping.

veg.n: Phuoc Tuy tofu rice paper rolls
veg.make_ahead: Up to 4 hours, keep covered with damp paper towel

steps.text: Soak the vermicelli in hot water, then drain.
Cut the tofu into strips, fry in the oil until golden and toss with a tablespoon of the soy.
Julienne the carrot and cucumber.
Dip the rice paper sheets one at a time in warm water for a few seconds.
Lay tofu, noodles, vegetables, mint and coriander on each and roll tightly.
Mix the rest of the soy, lime juice, sugar, water, garlic and chilli for dipping.

dishes.n: D Company field kitchen beef and beans
dishes.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, keep chilled and reheat

steps.text: Dice the chuck, onion, capsicum and garlic.
Brown the beef in batches in oil.
Add the onion, garlic and capsicum and cook.
Stir in the paprika, cumin, crushed tomatoes, stock and drained cannellini beans.
Cover and simmer until tender.
Cook the rice and stir through the butter.
Serve with sliced pickled chilli.

veg.n: D Company field kitchen mushrooms and beans
veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, keep chilled and reheat

steps.text: Quarter the mushrooms and dice the onion, capsicum and garlic.
Brown the mushrooms in batches in the oil.
Add the onion, garlic and capsicum and cook.
Stir in the paprika, cumin, crushed tomatoes, stock and drained cannellini beans.
Cover and simmer until thick.
Cook the rice and stir through the butter.
Serve with sliced pickled chilli.

veg.n: Delta Company caramel tofu and eggplant
veg.make_ahead: Braise up to 2 days ahead and reheat; skim the fat off the cold braise first

steps.text: Boil the eggs for 8 minutes, cool and peel. Cut the tofu and eggplant into chunks.
Fry the tofu and eggplant in the oil until golden and lift out.
Melt the sugar in the pot over medium heat until dark amber, then stir in the sliced shallots and garlic.
Add the soy, coconut water, tofu, eggplant and eggs and simmer for 20 minutes until sticky.
Simmer the rice with 450ml water, covered, for 12 minutes, then rest for 5.
Serve with the rice, sliced cucumber, spring onion and chilli.
Heat the cream with the orange zest until steaming.
Pour over the chopped chocolate, leave to melt and stir until smooth.
Stir in the orange juice.
Pour into small glasses.
Chill for 2 hours.
Simmer thin strips of orange zest in sugar and water.
Top the pots with whipped cream, the candied zest and crumbled shortbread.
